---
listing:
  contents: 
    - "**/*.md"
    - "**/*.qmd"
  fields: [date, title, description, categories]
  feed: true
  sort: "date desc"
  type: default
  categories: true
  sort-ui: false
page-layout: full
title-block-banner: true
resources:
  - infinite-scroll.js
include-after-body:
  - text: <script src="infinite-scroll.js"></script>
---
